evidence_policy: OBSERVED means present in pinned source, not executed. Native tests are NOT_RUN/BLOCKED. No physical-TV measurement was made.

capabilities.detail: Rust/SDL native launcher; TV GLES2/Wayland, desktop GL3.2; logical 1920x1080.
capabilities.falsification: A verified TV build/runtime showing a different backend or drawable invalidates the platform assumption.

capabilities.detail: State, Target, Overlay, Subpage and Effect own navigation; scene controls rebuilt before input.
capabilities.falsification: A second mutable focus/route owner accepting the same input would violate ownership.

capabilities.detail: One horizontal strip, shared card face, edge fades and whole-card remote reveal.
capabilities.falsification: A focused card remains clipped or pointer-down changes its position.

capabilities.detail: Six-column grid-index navigation including offscreen rows; fixed toolbar hit priority.
capabilities.falsification: Mid-grid Up reaches header instead of previous grid row.

capabilities.detail: Hover/down do not reveal-scroll; release must match original target.
capabilities.falsification: A press activates after its control moves or a stale snapshot changes the hit target.

capabilities.detail: 600 ms Back hold, system history, depth-sorted shared geometry, close/launch actions and stale-generation handling.
capabilities.falsification: A long press also executes short Back, or a stale reply changes restored focus.

capabilities.detail: Existing panel, wallpaper, notice and Recents motion fallback; preference defaults off.
capabilities.falsification: Enabling reduced motion leaves a covered animation running.

capabilities.detail: Interface, Background, Widgets, System with breadcrumbs and explicit parent restoration.
capabilities.falsification: Back loses the originating row or focus changes a saved preference.

capabilities.detail: Serde defaults/sanitization, private app-owned destination selection and atomic writes; corruption is not silently replaced.
capabilities.falsification: Malformed JSON is overwritten with defaults or a failed write destroys the previous file. Power-loss durability is not established.

capabilities.detail: Worker reads/decode; SDL-thread upload; version-aware keys, bounded input/decode/cache and visible priority.
capabilities.falsification: A worker performs GL uploads, stale tokens replace newer artwork, or cache limits grow without bound.

capabilities.detail: Lazy outlines, bounded glyph/run caches, lazy CJK/Hangul, MSAA or analytic fringe; no glyph bitmap atlas.
capabilities.falsification: Missing required glyphs, baseline drift or unbounded active-frame geometry.

capabilities.detail: Scene diff, buffer-age union, conservative text/state bounds, scissor/culling and full-redraw fallback.
capabilities.falsification: Authorized damage verification finds differences above its threshold, or an unsupported EGL path is reported active.

capabilities.detail: Prepare other pages after idle; one page per ordinary idle wake. Preparation can still do substantial first-use work.
capabilities.falsification: Prewarm causes unbounded idle wakeups, visible-frame stalls or cache churn.

capabilities.detail: Forced-redraw presentation-call cadence, CPU submission, timeline, p95, cache counters and damage verification.
capabilities.falsification: Treating CPU submission as GPU time or ordinary loop frames as presentations invalidates a result.

capabilities.detail: Only payload accounting; no trustworthy GPU allocation readout. 8/32/48 MiB are soft budgets across different classes.
capabilities.falsification: A calibrated device allocator/driver readout is required; arithmetic cannot establish actual GPU memory.

capabilities.detail: p99 derivable from timeline; direct input latency, idle wakeup counts and memory slope need instrumentation.
capabilities.falsification: No measured native samples exist; no performance claim is permitted.

capabilities.detail: Input-only refresh, cable/signal distinction, On/Off/Auto, labels and press-safe stale snapshots. CEC stack itself is platform-owned.
capabilities.falsification: Signal overrides cable state or input refresh changes apps/preferences/focus during a press.

capabilities.detail: Dedicated bounded workers/cache, fixed origins, no redirects/proxy, latest-job generations and Celsius cache.
capabilities.falsification: Hidden/unconfigured Home issues forecasts or stale replies replace a newer location.

capabilities.detail: Short-lived tokenized HTTP sessions on one local interface, action/origin checks, cancellation and bounded bodies/requests.
tests: the tile list is read without caching and rejected when malformed
changes are posted as JSON with the session token and report the TV’s error
capabilities.detail_tests: Dependency-free Node page tests passed; Rust session/server tests NOT_RUN.
capabilities.falsification: Expired/wrong-token/cross-site requests mutate state, or cancellation lets an old session overwrite a new one.

capabilities.detail: Existing release checksum/size/origin constraints and mocked Home/update wrapper contracts. No independent publisher signature established.
tests: checksum and install failures publish retryable failure, never launch
fullhome remains the launch and recovery target after an update
capabilities.detail_tests: Node shell-fixture tests passed; Rust/helper tests and real recovery NOT_RUN.
capabilities.falsification: A bad checksum launches the installer or recovery target changes. Physical recovery cannot be inferred from mocks.

capabilities.detail: Existing app/Home identities, LS2/GLib integration, helper boundaries and real auxiliary-vector compatibility. Unchanged.
capabilities.falsification: Any candidate diff to protected Home/platform paths is rejected at this audit gate.

capabilities.detail: Platform-owned, not implemented by Luma. Static dependency snapshot is not a live service census; DRM remains hard UNKNOWN.
capabilities.falsification: Only authorized feature-level device checks can establish preservation; no service may be disabled from inference.

capabilities.detail: No decoder/video primitive/media-plane owner. Separate supported player handoff exists; inline video needs API, copy, memory and lifecycle proof.
capabilities.falsification: A documented permitted hardware route plus owner-owned unprotected canary must prove playback, composition, cleanup and no protected-app regression.

capabilities.detail: Unapplied exact-env opt-in shadow-only candidate; no persistent setting or geometry change. Static scope contract passed; apply validation stopped after two failures and native tests are blocked.
capabilities.falsification: Default scene differs, controls move, damage omits old/new shadow, or native build/tests fail.
